articles.title: Not Just Rock: 66-Million-Year-Old Dino Bone Yields Original Proteins
articles.summary: A new study detected collagen in an Edmontosaurus fossil, challenging the idea that all organics decay. Multiple tests confirmed it's not contamination. This could revolutionize how we study extinct species.

articles.title: Perseverance's New Selfie Reveals Mars' Oldest Rocks and a Volcanic Past
articles.summary: A 61-image selfie shows the rover on the rim of Jezero Crater, examining ancient terrain. Scientists spotted a possible volcanic dike. The site could hold clues about early Martian crust and habitability.

articles.title: DNA Study Reveals a Third Ancestral Group Shaped Modern Japan
articles.summary: Whole-genome sequencing of 3,200 Japanese individuals uncovered a third ancestral component, likely Emishi-related. The findings challenge the notion of a homogenous population and refine migration history.
